endorsements.name: Teerachai Somprasong
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-14854
endorsements.description: The WP-CRM System plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized access due to missing capability checks on the wpcrm_get_email_recipients and wpcrm_system_ajax_task_change_status AJAX functions in all versions up to, and including, 3.4.5. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber level access and above, to enumerate CRM contact email addresses (PII disclosure) and modify CRM task statuses. 	CVE-2025-62106 is likely a duplicate of this issue.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.4)

endorsements.name: Teerachai Somprasong
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-15507
endorsements.description: The Magic Import Document Extractor plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized modification of data due to a missing capability check on the ajax_sync_usage() function in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.5. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to modify the plugin's license status and credit balance.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.3)

endorsements.name: Teerachai Somprasong
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-15508
endorsements.description: The Magic Import Document Extractor plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.4 via the get_frontend_settings() function. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to extract the site's magicimport.ai license key from the page source on any page containing the plugin's shortcode.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.3)
